items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.
items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复和iPSC药物发现的研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者研究历程的回顾性文章，总结了从神经发育基础研究到干细胞生物学、脊髓损伤修复和iPSC药物发现的转化路径。关键内容包括：Musashi蛋白在神经干细胞中的功能、成人脑神经干细胞的分离方法、iPSC来源神经干细胞移植治疗脊髓损伤的首次人体试验，以及利用患者iPSC筛选出ALS候选药物Ropinirole。文章强调未来再生医学需要多学科整合。
items.insight: 这篇文章由该领域资深研究者撰写，系统梳理了从基础神经发育研究到iPSC临床转化的完整路径，特别是ALS药物发现（Ropinirole）和脊髓损伤细胞治疗的进展，为ALS研究者提供了理解iPSC平台在疾病建模和药物筛选中的应用背景，以及未来再生治疗整合方向的参考。

aiRead.keyFinding: iPSC筛选发现Ropinirole作为ALS治疗候选药物，并已开展iPSC来源神经干细胞移植治疗脊髓损伤的首次人体试验。
aiRead.limitation: 作为回顾性文章，未提供新的实验数据，且部分内容为作者个人观点。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Ropinirole在ALS中的临床试验结果，以及iPSC细胞移植治疗脊髓损伤的后续临床数据。

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和iPSC药物发现的研究历程。早期工作聚焦于神经系统中RNA介导的调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了识别和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，从损伤病理生理学分析和分子干预，到使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终促成了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首次人体临床研究。与此同时，他们开发了患者来源的iPSC平台用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症中，基于iPSC的筛选确定了Ropinirole作为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章发表于2026年，总结了iPSC技术在ALS药物发现和脊髓损伤细胞治疗中的最新转化进展，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Neutralization of pathogenic PC-OxPL by AAV-delivered scFv as a therapeutic strategy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder defined by progressive motor neuron loss and TDP-43 proteinopathy, yet the upstream drivers of this pathology remain unclear. Oxidized phosphatidylcholines (PC-OxPL) have emerged as potent inducers of proteinopathy in the central nervous system (CNS), but their role in ALS has not been systematically explored. We identify a distinct PC-OxPL signature in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) of patients with sporadic ALS (sALS) and show that apolipoprotein E (apoE)-containing particles are the primary PC-OxPL carriers in this compartment. In human iPSC-derived motor neurons, PC-OxPL exposure triggered disease-relevant transcriptional alterations and TDP-43 pathology, establishing PC-OxPL as a mediator of ALS-like neurodegeneration in vitro . To counteract this toxicity, we engineered an Adeno-Associated Virus (AAV)-delivered single-chain antibody fragment (scFv), PC-OxPL-VecTab, targeting PC-OxPL neoepitopes. PC-OxPL-VecTab neutralized PC-OxPL-induced neurotoxicity, reduced TDP-43 aggregation, and prevented motor neuron death and behavioral deficits in a sALS CSF transfer mouse model. Intrathecal delivery of PC-OxPL-VecTab in minipigs achieved broad CNS biodistribution and transgene expression, supporting the feasibility of CNS delivery. These findings position PC-OxPL as a mechanistic contributor to ALS pathogenesis and establish PC-OxPL-VecTab as a therapeutic strategy for ALS with potential broader applicability to disorders associated with PC-OxPL accumulation.
items.titleZh: AAV递送的scFv中和致病性PC-OxPL作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症的治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，散发性ALS患者脑脊液中的氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）水平升高，并证实PC-OxPL能诱导运动神经元TDP-43病理和毒性。研究者开发了一种AAV递送的单链抗体（PC-OxPL-VecTab），在细胞和小鼠模型中能中和PC-OxPL毒性、减少TDP-43聚集并改善行为缺陷，且在小型猪中鞘内递送安全可行。该研究提示PC-OxPL可能是ALS的潜在治疗靶点。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统地将PC-OxPL与ALS发病机制联系起来，并提供了从患者样本到动物模型再到大型动物递送的完整证据链，为ALS治疗开辟了新的靶点方向，值得关注其后续临床转化进展。

aiRead.keyFinding: PC-OxPL在sALS患者CSF中富集，通过apoE颗粒介导，诱导TDP-43病理；AAV递送的scFv（PC-OxPL-VecTab）能中和毒性并改善小鼠模型症状。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于体外和动物模型，尚未进入人体临床试验；PC-OxPL在ALS中的因果作用仍需进一步验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注PC-OxPL-VecTab是否进入临床试验，以及PC-OxPL作为生物标志物的验证研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以进行性运动神经元丢失和TDP-43蛋白病为特征，但其上游驱动因素尚不清楚。氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）已被证明是中枢神经系统中蛋白病的强效诱导剂，但其在ALS中的作用尚未被系统探索。我们在散发性ALS（sALS）患者的脑脊液（CSF）中识别出独特的PC-OxPL特征，并显示含载脂蛋白E（apoE）的颗粒是该区室中PC-OxPL的主要载体。在人类iPSC来源的运动神经元中，PC-OxPL暴露触发了疾病相关的转录改变和TDP-43病理，确立了PC-OxPL作为ALS样神经退行性变的体外介质。为对抗这种毒性，我们工程化了一种AAV递送的单链抗体片段（scFv）PC-OxPL-VecTab，靶向PC-OxPL新表位。PC-OxPL-VecTab中和了PC-OxPL诱导的神经毒性，减少了TDP-43聚集，并在sALS CSF转移小鼠模型中防止了运动神经元死亡和行为缺陷。在小型猪中鞘内递送PC-OxPL-VecTab实现了广泛的中枢神经系统生物分布和转基因表达，支持CNS递送的可行性。这些发现将PC-OxPL定位为ALS发病机制的机制性贡献者，并确立PC-OxPL-VecTab作为ALS的治疗策略，可能对与PC-OxPL积累相关的疾病具有更广泛的适用性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，首次将PC-OxPL确立为ALS的机制性靶点，并展示了AAV递送抗体在大型动物中的可行性，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Cell Death in Neurodegenerative Diseases: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Targets.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDs) are marked by selective neuronal vulnerability and progressive failure of neural circuits. Increasing evidence indicates that neuronal loss is not driven by a single terminal event, but emerges from interacting regulated cell death (RCD) programs. These programs are closely coupled to mitochondrial injury, proteostatic collapse, lysosomal stress, metabolic imbalance, glial state transitions, and chronic neuroinflammation. Yet, how distinct death pathways are organized across cell types, disease stages, and disease-specific microenvironments remains unresolved. This review examines RCD as an integrated pathogenic network in major NDs. Caspase and B-cell lymphoma 2 (BCL2) family signaling, receptor-interacting protein kinase 1 (RIPK1), RIPK3, and mixed lineage kinase domain-like protein activation, NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain containing 3 and gasdermin signaling, GPX4-linked lipid peroxidation control, and autophagy lysosomal failure are discussed as convergent stress response modules rather than isolated pathways. Across Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and Huntington's disease, these modules shape neuronal fate through disease-specific interactions with mitochondrial dysfunction, iron dyshomeostasis, inflammasome activation, and microglial metabolic remodeling. We further evaluate emerging therapeutic strategies that target cell death crosstalk, restore autophagy lysosomal competence, or improve delivery to the central nervous system, highlighting the importance of molecular selectivity, cellular context, disease stage, and translational feasibility.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中的细胞死亡：分子机制与治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提出，神经退行性疾病中的神经元死亡不是单一事件，而是由多种调节性细胞死亡程序（如凋亡、坏死性凋亡、焦亡、铁死亡和自噬性死亡）相互作用形成的网络。这些程序与线粒体损伤、蛋白稳态失衡、神经炎症等密切相关，并在不同疾病（包括ALS）中表现出特异性。文章还讨论了针对这些死亡途径的潜在治疗策略，强调需要结合疾病阶段和细胞背景进行精准干预。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了细胞死亡机制的综合框架，有助于理解ALS中运动神经元死亡的复杂性，并指导开发针对多个死亡途径的联合治疗策略。

aiRead.keyFinding: 神经退行性疾病中的细胞死亡是由多种RCD程序相互作用的网络驱动的，而非单一途径。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供新的实验数据，且对具体疾病（如ALS）的机制细节讨论有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对细胞死亡串扰的联合治疗策略在ALS动物模型中的验证，以及RIPK1抑制剂等药物在临床试验中的进展。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDs）以选择性神经元易损性和神经回路进行性衰竭为特征。越来越多的证据表明，神经元丢失并非由单一终末事件驱动，而是源于相互作用的调节性细胞死亡（RCD）程序。这些程序与线粒体损伤、蛋白稳态崩溃、溶酶体应激、代谢失衡、胶质细胞状态转变和慢性神经炎症密切相关。然而，不同死亡途径如何在细胞类型、疾病阶段和疾病特异性微环境中组织仍不清楚。本综述将RCD视为主要神经退行性疾病中的整合致病网络。讨论了半胱天冬酶和B细胞淋巴瘤2（BCL2）家族信号、受体相互作用蛋白激酶1（RIPK1）、RIPK3和混合谱系激酶结构域样蛋白激活、NOD样受体家族pyrin结构域包含3和gasdermin信号、GPX4相关的脂质过氧化控制以及自噬溶酶体衰竭，这些被视为汇聚的应激反应模块而非孤立途径。在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和亨廷顿病中，这些模块通过与线粒体功能障碍、铁稳态失调、炎症小体激活和小胶质细胞代谢重塑的疾病特异性相互作用来塑造神经元命运。我们进一步评估了针对细胞死亡串扰、恢复自噬溶酶体能力或改善中枢神经系统递送的新兴治疗策略，强调了分子选择性、细胞背景、疾病阶段和转化可行性的重要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新的调节性细胞死亡研究进展，并强调了其在ALS等疾病中的转化治疗潜力，具有高度的时效性和临床相关性。

items.title: Neuron-derived neuroinflammation in neurodegenerative diseases: Mechanisms and intervention prospects.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases represent a major global public health challenge, imposing substantial societal and economic burdens. Their complex pathogenesis and limited therapeutic options underscore an urgent need for new paradigms. Emerging evidence indicates that dysregulation of the brain's immune microenvironment is a critical driver of disease progression. Conventional wisdom posits that peripheral immune cells and central glial cells serve as the primary initiators of neuroimmune responses, whereas neurons are regarded merely as passive recipients of inflammatory damage. Emerging evidence suggests that upon receiving pathological signals in the central nervous system, neurons may become more vulnerable and participate in the onset of neuroimmune processes, positioning them as potential targets for early intervention in neurodegenerative diseases. This article systematically reviews the contribution of neuron-derived immune-inflammatory responses in neurodegenerative diseases and potential intervention strategies. We first outline the capacity of neurons to regulate neuroimmune responses and detail the underlying molecular mechanisms. Then we compare the specific mechanisms by which neurons with different susceptibility drive and amplify neuroinflammation in various neurodegenerative diseases such as alzheimer's disease, parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, vascular cognitive impairment, and transformed these mechanisms into intervention strategies targeting neurons. This article aims to break through the traditional concept of passive neuronal damage, systematically integrate intervention strategies that shift from targeting peripheral immune and glial cells to regulating neuron-derived immunity, thereby providing a new theoretical framework for overcoming current clinical limitations and identifying effective therapeutic targets for the prevention and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases.
items.titleZh: 神经元来源的神经炎症在神经退行性疾病中的作用：机制与干预前景
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提出一个观点：神经元不只是神经炎症的受害者，它们也能主动参与并放大炎症反应。文章梳理了神经元如何调控免疫反应，以及在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、ALS等疾病中，不同易感性的神经元如何驱动神经炎症。作者认为，把治疗思路从只盯着免疫细胞和胶质细胞，转向调节神经元自身的免疫功能，可能为ALS等疾病提供新的干预方向。
items.insight: 这篇综述对ALS研究者的价值在于，它系统性地将神经元从'被动受损者'重新定位为'主动参与者'，提示ALS的神经炎症治疗或许可以从调节运动神经元自身的免疫信号入手，这可能为目前疗效有限的抗炎治疗提供新的靶点思路。

aiRead.keyFinding: 神经元在接收到病理信号后并非被动受损，而是能够主动启动和放大神经免疫反应，因此可作为神经退行性疾病早期干预的潜在靶点。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，其结论基于已发表文献的整合，缺乏原始实验数据；且将不同疾病中神经元驱动炎症的机制进行横向比较，可能存在简化风险。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否有针对神经元源性炎症信号通路（如特定转录因子或分泌因子）的动物模型干预研究，以及这些发现能否在ALS临床试验中转化为可检测的生物标志物或治疗策略。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病构成重大的全球公共卫生挑战，带来沉重的社会和经济负担。其复杂的发病机制和有限的治疗选择凸显了对新范式的迫切需求。新出现的证据表明，大脑免疫微环境的失调是疾病进展的关键驱动因素。传统观点认为，外周免疫细胞和中枢胶质细胞是神经免疫反应的主要启动者，而神经元仅被视为炎症损伤的被动接受者。新出现的证据表明，神经元在接收到中枢神经系统的病理信号后，可能变得更容易受损，并参与神经免疫过程的启动，使其成为神经退行性疾病早期干预的潜在靶点。本文系统综述了神经元来源的免疫炎症反应在神经退行性疾病中的作用及潜在干预策略。作者首先概述了神经元调节神经免疫反应的能力，并详细介绍了其潜在的分子机制。然后比较了不同易感性的神经元在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化、血管性认知障碍等多种神经退行性疾病中驱动和放大神经炎症的具体机制，并将这些机制转化为针对神经元的干预策略。本文旨在突破神经元被动损伤的传统观念，系统整合从靶向外周免疫和胶质细胞转向调节神经元来源免疫的干预策略，从而为克服当前临床局限性、确定有效的治疗靶点以预防和治疗神经退行性疾病提供新的理论框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了近年关于神经元主动参与神经免疫调控的新证据，为ALS等疾病的抗炎治疗提供了从靶向胶质细胞转向靶向神经元的转化性新框架。

items.title: Recent advances in neurodegenerative diseases therapeutics: The inhibition of monoacylglycerol lipase strategy.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases share common pathophysiological mechanisms, including chronic neuroinflammation, glutamatergic excitotoxicity, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and disruptions in synaptic and lipid homeostasis. In this context, the endocannabinoid system has emerged as a key modulator of neuroimmune communication and neuronal survival. Within this system, Monoacylglycerol Lipase (MAGL) plays a central role by regulating the levels of the endocannabinoid 2-Arachidonoylglycerol (2-AG) while simultaneously contributing to the generation of arachidonic acid and pro-inflammatory eicosanoids. Pharmacological or genetic inhibition of MAGL increases 2-AG levels and concurrently reduces the biosynthesis of pro-inflammatory lipid mediators, thereby modulating microglial activation, astrocytic responses, and neuronal excitotoxicity. Preclinical studies in models of Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis consistently demonstrate that MAGL blockade attenuates neuroinflammation, preserves synaptic and neuronal integrity, improves motor and cognitive function, and, in some cases, delays disease progression. Although clinical evidence remains limited, the available data position MAGL as a metabolic convergence point between inflammation and neurodegeneration, suggesting that its modulation may represent a therapeutic strategy with disease-modifying potential.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病治疗的最新进展：单酰基甘油脂肪酶抑制策略
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了MAGL抑制在多种神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）中的治疗潜力。MAGL是内源性大麻素系统中的一个关键酶，抑制它可提高2-AG水平并减少促炎性脂质介质，从而减轻神经炎症和兴奋性毒性。临床前研究显示，在ALS等模型中，MAGL阻断可改善运动功能并延缓疾病进展，但临床证据仍有限。
items.insight: 该综述将MAGL定位为炎症与神经退行性变之间的代谢汇聚点，为ALS研究者提供了新的治疗靶点思路，尤其是其疾病修饰潜力值得关注。

aiRead.keyFinding: MAGL抑制在多种神经退行性疾病模型中减轻神经炎症并改善功能，可能具有疾病修饰潜力。
aiRead.limitation: 临床证据有限，主要基于临床前研究。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注MAGL抑制剂在ALS患者中的临床试验结果。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病具有共同的病理生理机制，包括慢性神经炎症、谷氨酸能兴奋性毒性、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍以及突触和脂质稳态的破坏。在此背景下，内源性大麻素系统已成为神经免疫通讯和神经元存活的关键调节因子。在该系统中，单酰基甘油脂肪酶（MAGL）通过调节内源性大麻素2-花生四烯酸甘油（2-AG）的水平发挥核心作用，同时促进花生四烯酸和促炎性类花生酸的生成。药理学或遗传学抑制MAGL可增加2-AG水平，同时减少促炎性脂质介质的生物合成，从而调节小胶质细胞活化、星形胶质细胞反应和神经元兴奋性毒性。在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多发性硬化症和肌萎缩侧索硬化症模型中的临床前研究一致表明，MAGL阻断可减轻神经炎症，保护突触和神经元完整性，改善运动和认知功能，并在某些情况下延缓疾病进展。尽管临床证据仍然有限，现有数据将MAGL定位为炎症与神经退行性变之间的代谢汇聚点，提示其调节可能代表一种具有疾病修饰潜力的治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦MAGL抑制这一新兴策略，在ALS等模型中显示出疾病修饰潜力，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: High-dose methylcobalamin in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: mechanistic rationale, translational evidence, and clinical implications.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive and fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by selective degeneration of upper and lower motor neurons, driven by converging mechanisms including glutamatergic excitotoxicity, mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, calcium dyshomeostasis, impaired RNA metabolism, and neuroinflammation. In the absence of effective disease-modifying therapies, high-dose methylcobalamin has emerged as a candidate intervention based on its pleiotropic neurobiological effects. A structured literature search was conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE and ScienceDirect to identify peer-reviewed studies published between January 2017 and December 2025 addressing the mechanistic, preclinical, and clinical effects of methylcobalamin in ALS. Preclinical evidence suggests that methylcobalamin modulates homocysteine metabolism, supports S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methylation pathways, preserves mitochondrial integrity, attenuates oxidative stress, and promotes axonal regeneration. Experimental and translational findings further indicate that its therapeutic effects may be strongly dose dependent, particularly under ultra-high-dose regimens capable of overcoming limitations in central nervous system delivery. Clinical trials evaluating ultra-high-dose methylcobalamin demonstrate a potential attenuation of functional decline in patients treated during early disease stages, although effects on survival and respiratory outcomes remain inconsistent. This narrative review integrates molecular mechanisms, experimental evidence, biomarker research, and clinical trial data to examine the translational relevance, stage dependency, and therapeutic implications of high-dose methylcobalamin in ALS.

items.titleZh: 大剂量甲钴胺治疗肌萎缩侧索硬化症：机制依据、转化证据与临床意义
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述系统梳理了大剂量甲钴胺治疗ALS的现有证据。核心观点是：甲钴胺通过调节同型半胱氨酸代谢、支持甲基化通路、保护线粒体、减轻氧化应激和促进轴突再生等机制发挥作用，且效果可能高度依赖剂量。临床试验提示，超高剂量甲钴胺在疾病早期可能延缓功能衰退，但对生存期和呼吸功能的影响尚不明确。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种进行性、致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是上、下运动神经元的选择性变性，由多种汇聚机制驱动，包括谷氨酸能兴奋性毒性、线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激、钙稳态失调、RNA代谢受损和神经炎症。在缺乏有效疾病修饰疗法的情况下，大剂量甲钴胺因其多效性神经生物学效应而成为一种候选干预措施。在PubMed/MEDLINE和ScienceDirect中进行了结构化文献检索，以识别2017年1月至2025年12月间发表的、涉及甲钴胺在ALS中机制、临床前和临床效果的同行评审研究。临床前证据表明，甲钴胺调节同型半胱氨酸代谢，支持S-腺苷甲硫氨酸依赖性甲基化通路，维持线粒体完整性，减轻氧化应激，并促进轴突再生。实验和转化研究结果进一步表明，其治疗效果可能具有强烈的剂量依赖性，尤其是在能够克服中枢神经系统递送限制的超高剂量方案下。评估超高剂量甲钴胺的临床试验显示，在疾病早期阶段治疗的患者中，功能衰退可能得到延缓，但对生存期和呼吸结局的影响仍不一致。本叙述性综述整合了分子机制、实验证据、生物标志物研究和临床试验数据，以检验大剂量甲钴胺在ALS中的转化相关性、分期依赖性和治疗意义。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦于2025年12月前的近期文献，系统评估了超高剂量甲钴胺这一候选疗法在ALS早期阶段的转化价值，具有明确的ALS相关性和临床转化意义。

items.title: Engineered autophagy receptors administered with extracellular vesicles eliminate pathological Tau and TDP-43.
items.summary: In neurodegenerative diseases such as frontotemporal dementia and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, pathological forms of proteins such as Tau and TDP-43 accumulate within large heterogeneous inclusions inside cells. Current strategies to eliminate such aberrant protein species in patients encounter three main challenges: crossing the blood-brain barrier and plasma membrane, specifically recognizing pathological forms of proteins, and engaging mechanisms to eliminate large entities. Here we fuse LC3A, a central protein in the recruitment of substrates into autophagosomes, to cytoplasm-stable antibodies. These engineered autophagy receptors, targeting Tau or TDP-43, are delivered using small extracellular vesicles and reduce pathology in models, including Tau P301S adult primary mouse neurons, TDP-43 G298S iPSC-derived motor neurons and after intravenous injection in Tau P301S mice. Similarly, adeno-associated-virus-mediated delivery in TDP-43 ΔNLS mice enhances clearance of pathological TDP-43. This targeted degradation strategy allows delivery into the brain while capitalizing on the specificity of antibodies and the ability of autophagy to degrade large intracellular entities.

items.titleZh: 工程化自噬受体经细胞外囊泡递送清除病理性 Tau 和 TDP-43
items.summaryZh: 该研究开发了一种新型靶向蛋白降解技术，将自噬关键蛋白 LC3A 与抗体融合，形成工程化自噬受体，通过细胞外囊泡或病毒载体递送，可特异性清除神经元内病理性 Tau 和 TDP-43 聚集体。在多种 ALS 和 FTD 相关细胞及小鼠模型中验证了有效性，为清除 ALS 中 TDP-43 病理提供了新思路。
items.insight: 该研究首次将自噬受体与抗体结合并通过细胞外囊泡递送，实现了对病理性 TDP-43 和 Tau 的特异性清除，为 ALS 等疾病中难以靶向的蛋白聚集体提供了可行的治疗策略，值得关注其后续转化潜力。

items.abstractZh: 在额颞叶痴呆和肌萎缩侧索硬化等神经退行性疾病中，Tau 和 TDP-43 等蛋白的病理性形式在细胞内的大型异质包涵体中积累。目前消除患者体内此类异常蛋白的策略面临三大挑战：穿越血脑屏障和质膜、特异性识别病理性蛋白形式、以及启动清除大型实体的机制。本研究将 LC3A（自噬体底物招募的核心蛋白）与细胞质稳定抗体融合，构建了靶向 Tau 或 TDP-43 的工程化自噬受体，并通过小细胞外囊泡递送。在 Tau P301S 成年原代小鼠神经元、TDP-43 G298S iPSC 衍生运动神经元以及 Tau P301S 小鼠静脉注射模型中，该策略减少了病理。同样，在 TDP-43 ΔNLS 小鼠中，腺相关病毒介导的递送增强了病理性 TDP-43 的清除。这种靶向降解策略能够递送入脑，同时利用抗体的特异性和自噬降解大型细胞内实体的能力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究结合了新型递送系统（细胞外囊泡）和精准靶向（抗体-自噬受体融合），在 ALS 相关 TDP-43 病理模型中展示了体内清除效果，具有高度转化价值。

items.title: It's Virtually Here: Telemedicine, Virtual Care, and Neuromuscular Disease.
items.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic forced a partial shift in neuromuscular clinical practice away from in-person care to remote means. However, this shift was unexpected, abrupt, reactive to the emergency of a pandemic, and disruptive to the usual manner of care, without adequate time to adapt or study the optimal manner to provide care remotely. While traditionally associated with hub-and-spoke telemedicine models, the pandemic popularized direct-to-home virtual care, mostly unsupported by on-site examiners or standardized platforms. In chronic neuromuscular disorders such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and myasthenia gravis (MG), virtual care has demonstrated feasibility, patient satisfaction, and potential cost savings, particularly for geographically or functionally disadvantaged populations. Disease-specific adaptations such as the Myasthenia Gravis Core Exam and wearable-based assessments (e.g., home spirometry, grip strength monitoring, and digital outcome measures) have enabled more structured remote evaluations. However, diagnostic accuracy may be compromised by the inability to perform detailed neurological examinations or electrodiagnostic studies. Equity concerns persist due to variability in digital literacy, internet and digital device access, and socioeconomic status. Post-pandemic, patients with disabilities may continue to benefit in a combined virtual/in-person paradigm of care. More evidence is required to evaluate the impact of virtual care on neuromuscular practice quality of care and outcomes. We outline some of the questions that require further study, hoping to spur research and quality improvement investigations of these new care models.
items.titleZh: 它实际上已经到来：远程医疗、虚拟护理与神经肌肉疾病。
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述讨论了 COVID-19 大流行后神经肌肉疾病（包括 ALS）远程医疗的兴起。文章指出，虚拟护理在 ALS 和重症肌无力中显示出可行性和患者满意度，但存在诊断准确性受限和数字鸿沟等挑战。作者呼吁更多研究来评估虚拟护理对护理质量和结局的影响。
items.insight: 对于 ALS 研究者，这篇综述提供了远程医疗在神经肌肉疾病中应用的现状和未解决的问题，强调了虚拟护理在 ALS 管理中的潜在价值，以及需要进一步研究的方向，如远程评估工具的有效性和公平性问题。

aiRead.keyFinding: 虚拟护理在 ALS 和 MG 中可行且患者满意，但诊断准确性受限，且存在数字鸿沟。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始数据，且未系统评估虚拟护理对长期结局的影响。

items.abstractZh: COVID-19 大流行迫使神经肌肉临床实践部分从面对面护理转向远程方式。然而，这一转变是出乎意料、突然的，是对大流行紧急情况的反应，并扰乱了常规护理模式，没有足够的时间来适应或研究提供远程护理的最佳方式。虽然传统上与中心辐射式远程医疗模式相关，但大流行普及了直接到家的虚拟护理，大多没有现场检查者或标准化平台的支持。在慢性神经肌肉疾病如肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和重症肌无力（MG）中，虚拟护理已显示出可行性、患者满意度和潜在的成本节约，特别是对于地理或功能上处于劣势的人群。疾病特异性适应措施，如重症肌无力核心检查和基于可穿戴设备的评估（例如，家庭肺活量测定、握力监测和数字结局指标），使得更结构化的远程评估成为可能。然而，诊断准确性可能因无法进行详细的神经系统检查或电诊断研究而受到影响。由于数字素养、互联网和数字设备访问以及社会经济地位的差异，公平性问题仍然存在。大流行后，残疾患者可能继续受益于虚拟/面对面相结合的护理模式。需要更多证据来评估虚拟护理对神经肌肉实践护理质量和结局的影响。我们概述了一些需要进一步研究的问题，希望推动对这些新护理模式的研究和质量改进调查。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章发表于 2026 年，反映了后疫情时代神经肌肉疾病护理模式的转变，直接涉及 ALS 患者的远程护理实践，具有转化价值。

items.title: Temporal trends in motor neuron disease mortality in Spain (2000-2024): Population ageing versus generational risk factors.
items.summary: To analyse temporal trends in motor neuron disease (MND) mortality in Spain (2000-2024) and disentangle the independent contributions of age, period, and birth cohort effects. A population-based ecological time-series analysis was conducted using nationwide mortality data. Age-standardised mortality rates (ASMR) were analysed using joinpoint regression (ages 0-85+). To isolate underlying drivers and mitigate random variability, age-period-cohort (A-P-C) modelling was applied to a targeted adult cohort (ages 25-84). A total of 23,663 MND deaths were recorded. Absolute annual deaths rose by 81.1% (682 in 2000 to 1235 in 2024). Men showed a steady upward ASMR trend (AAPC: 0.5%; 95% CI 0.3-0.7). Women showed an initial sharp increase (2000-2003; APC: 7.0%; 95% CI 0.7-19.1) followed by stabilisation (APC: 0.1%; 95% CI -1.3 to 0.5). The A-P-C model revealed strong cohort effects in both sexes, with an inverted U-shaped pattern peaking in the 1950-1955 cohorts, followed by marked declines. Period effects in men showed stability, whilst a moderate secular decline was observed in women. Local trends revealed declines in the younger cohorts and an increase in mortality risks limited to the older age groups (75-84 years). The rising absolute MND mortality burden in Spain is primarily driven by population ageing rather than a generalised increase in lifetime risk. Long-term trends are heavily shaped by generational birth-cohort dynamics, showing a notable risk reduction in more recent generations.
items.titleZh: 西班牙运动神经元病死亡率的时序趋势（2000-2024年）：人口老龄化与世代风险因素
items.summaryZh: 西班牙2000-2024年运动神经元病死亡数据（23,663例）显示，绝对死亡人数增加81.1%，但年龄标准化死亡率仅男性小幅上升（每年0.5%），女性先升后稳。年龄-时期-队列分析表明，死亡负担上升主要源于人口老龄化，而非各年龄段风险普遍增加；1950-1955年出生队列风险最高，之后出生的人群风险显著下降。
items.insight: 这项大规模全国性研究为ALS/MND的流行病学提供了关键证据：死亡负担上升不等于发病率上升，世代效应提示环境或生活方式因素可能对出生队列产生长期影响，值得追踪以寻找潜在的可干预风险因素。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在分析西班牙运动神经元病（MND）死亡率在2000年至2024年间的时序趋势，并区分年龄、时期和出生队列效应的独立贡献。研究采用基于全国死亡数据的群体生态学时间序列分析。使用连接点回归（年龄0-85+岁）分析年龄标准化死亡率（ASMR）。为分离潜在驱动因素并减少随机变异，对目标成人队列（25-84岁）应用了年龄-时期-队列（A-P-C）模型。共记录了23,663例MND死亡。绝对年死亡数上升了81.1%（从2000年的682例增至2024年的1235例）。男性ASMR呈稳定上升趋势（AAPC：0.5%；95% CI 0.3-0.7）。女性最初急剧上升（2000-2003年；APC：7.0%；95% CI 0.7-19.1），随后趋于稳定（APC：0.1%；95% CI -1.3至0.5）。A-P-C模型显示两性均存在强烈的队列效应，呈倒U型模式，在1950-1955年出生队列达到峰值，随后显著下降。男性时期效应保持稳定，而女性观察到中度长期下降。局部趋势显示较年轻队列的风险下降，而死亡风险的增加仅限于老年组（75-84岁）。西班牙MND绝对死亡负担的上升主要由人口老龄化驱动，而非终生风险普遍增加。长期趋势受世代出生队列动态的强烈影响，较近期世代的发病风险显著降低。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用2000-2024年最新全国死亡数据，通过年龄-时期-队列模型首次清晰分离出西班牙MND死亡率的世代效应，具有直接的ALS流行病学转化价值。

items.title: Biallelic SIGMAR1 variants in early-onset distal hereditary motor neuropathy: A Japanese case series.
items.summary: BackgroundDistal hereditary motor neuropathy (dHMN) is characterized by slowly progressive distal muscle weakness and amyotrophy, and it exhibits clinical overlap with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Biallelic variants in SIGMAR1 , encoding sigma nonopioid intracellular receptor 1, have been linked to autosomal recessive dHMN with pyramidal features. This study investigated the clinical and genetic features of patients with dHMN associated with SIGMAR1 variants in Japan.MethodsWe conducted genetic screening of Japanese patients with clinically suspected inherited peripheral neuropathies using targeted gene panels and whole-exome sequencing. SIGMAR1 variants were evaluated via segregation analysis using Sanger sequencing. Detailed clinical and electrophysiological data were systematically reviewed.ResultsBiallelic SIGMAR1 variants, including three novel variants and one previously reported variant, were identified in six patients from five unrelated families. The genotypes comprised compound heterozygous variants in four patients and homozygous variants in two patients. All patients presented with early-onset distal muscle weakness and atrophy. Enhanced tendon reflexes and pyramidal tract signs were frequently observed, whereas bulbar or respiratory involvement was absent. Nerve conduction studies consistently revealed motor-predominant axonal neuropathy with minimal sensory involvement. Disease progression was slow, and all patients remained ambulatory for years to decades after onset.ConclusionOur findings expand the clinical and genetic spectrum of SIGMAR1 -associated disease and support its classification as dHMN rather than ALS. SIGMAR1 variants should be considered in the genetic evaluation of early-onset motor neuropathies, particularly in patients with dHMN accompanied by pyramidal features.
items.titleZh: 双等位基因SIGMAR1变异在早发性远端遗传性运动神经病中的表现：日本病例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 日本研究团队通过基因筛查在6名早发性远端遗传性运动神经病（dHMN）患者中发现了SIGMAR1基因的双等位基因变异，其中3个为新变异。患者主要表现为缓慢进展的远端肌无力和萎缩，常伴腱反射亢进和锥体束征，但无延髓或呼吸受累。电生理检查提示运动为主的轴索性神经病。研究支持SIGMAR1相关疾病应归类为dHMN而非ALS，并建议在早发性运动神经病的遗传检测中纳入SIGMAR1。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS鉴别诊断提供了重要线索：SIGMAR1双等位基因变异导致的早发性运动神经病在临床上与ALS重叠，但预后相对良好，明确其遗传分类有助于避免误诊，并可能为ALS的SIGMAR1相关通路研究提供参考。

items.abstractZh: 背景：远端遗传性运动神经病（dHMN）以缓慢进展的远端肌无力和肌萎缩为特征，与腓骨肌萎缩症和肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）存在临床重叠。编码σ非阿片类细胞内受体1的SIGMAR1基因双等位基因变异已被认为与常染色体隐性遗传的dHMN伴锥体束征相关。本研究调查了日本dHMN患者中SIGMAR1变异的临床和遗传特征。方法：使用靶向基因面板和全外显子测序对临床疑似遗传性周围神经病的日本患者进行遗传筛查。通过Sanger测序进行分离分析评估SIGMAR1变异。系统回顾了详细的临床和电生理数据。结果：在来自5个无关家庭的6名患者中鉴定出双等位基因SIGMAR1变异，包括3个新变异和1个先前报道的变异。基因型包括4名患者的复合杂合变异和2名患者的纯合变异。所有患者均表现为早发性远端肌无力和萎缩。腱反射亢进和锥体束征常见，而延髓或呼吸受累缺失。神经传导研究一致显示运动为主的轴索性神经病，感觉受累轻微。疾病进展缓慢，所有患者在发病后数年至数十年内仍能行走。结论：我们的发现扩大了SIGMAR1相关疾病的临床和遗传谱，支持其分类为dHMN而非ALS。在早发性运动神经病的遗传评估中应考虑SIGMAR1变异，特别是伴有锥体束征的dHMN患者。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的日本病例系列，扩展了SIGMAR1相关疾病的遗传和临床谱，对ALS鉴别诊断具有直接转化价值。

items.title: Beyond the Ribosome: The Expanding Role of the Nucleolus in Neurodegenerative Pathways.
items.summary: The nucleolus, long defined by its canonical role in ribosome biogenesis, has emerged as a critical nexus for cellular homeostasis, stress sensing, and disease pathogenesis. This article synthesizes a broad range of evidence to construct a comprehensive model of the nucleolus in the context of aging and neurodegeneration. We begin by detailing its fundamental architecture and the intricate process of ribosome production, before exploring the paradigm-shifting discovery of its vast, non-canonical proteome, which implicates it in DNA repair, cell cycle control, and genome stability. A central theme is the nucleolus's function as a primary cellular stress sensor, which, upon disruption by genetic, metabolic, or proteotoxic insults, initiates the nucleolar stress response. We provide a detailed examination of the downstream signaling cascades, focusing on the canonical p53-MDM2 axis and the interconnected mTOR pathway, which together translate nucleolar status into decisions of cell fate, including apoptosis and cell cycle arrest. We then focus on the brain, presenting the neuropathological and morphological alterations of the nucleolus-such as atrophy, fragmentation, and changes in volume-that serve as hallmarks of normal aging and neurodegenerative disorders, including Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and C9orf72-linked ALS/FTD. We explore the deep regulatory layers of epigenetics, where DNA methylation and histone modifications of ribosomal DNA genes are dysregulated in disease, and discuss how multi-omics approaches are unraveling the complex molecular landscape of nucleolar function. Finally, we introduce the emerging concept of a gut-brain-nucleolus axis, proposing how systemic factors like the gut microbiome may influence neuronal health by triggering nucleolar stress through inflammatory and metabolic mediators. Overall, by highlighting the nucleolus as a convergence point for diverse pathogenic pathways, we frame it as a promising and druggable target for novel therapeutic strategies aimed at promoting neuronal resilience and combating neurodegenerative diseases.
items.titleZh: 超越核糖体：核仁在神经退行性通路中不断扩展的作用
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述文章总结了核仁在神经退行性疾病中的新角色，指出核仁不仅是核糖体合成的场所，还是细胞应激的关键传感器。文章重点讨论了核仁应激反应如何通过p53和mTOR通路影响细胞命运，并描述了在ALS（特别是C9orf72相关）、阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病中观察到的核仁形态异常。此外，文章提出了一个新兴的“肠-脑-核仁轴”概念，认为肠道微生物可能通过炎症和代谢信号影响神经元核仁功能。作者认为核仁是多种致病通路的汇聚点，可能成为未来治疗干预的靶点。
items.insight: 这篇综述为ALS研究者提供了核仁作为应激传感器和疾病靶点的新视角，特别是C9orf72相关ALS/FTD中核仁形态改变和应激反应失调的机制，可能启发新的治疗策略。

aiRead.keyFinding: 核仁在神经退行性疾病中作为应激传感器，其形态改变和应激反应失调是疾病标志，且核仁可能成为可药用靶点。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，内容基于已有研究，缺乏原始实验数据；提出的肠-脑-核仁轴概念尚需更多验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续关于核仁应激反应在ALS动物模型中的干预研究，以及针对核仁靶点的药物开发进展。

items.abstractZh: 核仁长期以来以其在核糖体生物发生中的经典作用被定义，但现已显现为细胞稳态、应激感知和疾病发病机制的关键节点。本文综合了广泛的证据，构建了核仁在衰老和神经退行性疾病背景下的综合模型。我们首先详细描述其基本结构和核糖体产生的复杂过程，然后探讨其庞大的非经典蛋白质组的范式转变性发现，该蛋白质组涉及DNA修复、细胞周期控制和基因组稳定性。一个核心主题是核仁作为主要细胞应激传感器的功能，当受到遗传、代谢或蛋白毒性损伤时，会启动核仁应激反应。我们详细检查了下游信号级联，重点关注经典的p53-MDM2轴和相互关联的mTOR通路，它们共同将核仁状态转化为细胞命运的决定，包括凋亡和细胞周期停滞。然后我们聚焦于大脑，呈现核仁的神经病理学和形态学改变——如萎缩、碎裂和体积变化——这些是正常衰老和神经退行性疾病（包括帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和C9orf72相关的ALS/FTD）的标志。我们探索了表观遗传学的深层调控层，其中核糖体DNA基因的DNA甲基化和组蛋白修饰在疾病中失调，并讨论了多组学方法如何揭示核仁功能的复杂分子景观。最后，我们引入了肠-脑-核仁轴的新兴概念，提出肠道微生物组等系统性因素可能通过炎症和代谢介质触发核仁应激，从而影响神经元健康。总体而言，通过强调核仁作为多种致病通路的汇聚点，我们将其定位为促进神经元弹性和对抗神经退行性疾病的新型治疗策略的有前景且可药用的靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了核仁非经典功能和应激反应的最新证据，并提出了肠-脑-核仁轴的新概念，对ALS等神经退行性疾病的机制研究和治疗靶点开发具有转化价值。

items.title: JP1 peptide modulates oxidative stress and autophagy via Keap1-Nrf2-ARE in ALS model mice.
items.summary: The simultaneous modulation of oxidative stress and autophagy represents a potential therapeutic strategy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), yet agents capable of coordinately regulating both processes remain scarce. The Keap1‑Nrf2‑ARE pathway serves as a critical hub linking redox homeostasis and autophagic regulation, making it an attractive target for ALS intervention. JWA is a stress‑responsive protein involved in cellular protection against oxidative injury, and its neuroprotective effects have been shown to depend on activation of the MEK/ERK‑Nrf2 axis. JP1 is a functional oligopeptide derived from the JWA protein that has been engineered to cross the blood-brain barrier and specifically target integrin αVβ3. Based on the link between JWA and Nrf2 signaling, we hypothesized that JP1 activates the Keap1‑Nrf2‑ARE pathway to coordinate antioxidant defense and autophagic clearance. Here, we evaluated this hypothesis in the SOD1‑G93A mouse model, a well‑established transgenic model of familial ALS, and elucidated the underlying mechanisms. We evaluated the efficacy of JP1 in the SOD1-G93A mice model using behavioral phenotyping and survival analysis. The coordinated mechanism was investigated in spinal cord tissues by profiling the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway and oxidative stress, quantifying autophagic flux (by Western blotting and transmission electron microscopy) and neuronal apoptosis, and evaluating histology (by Nissl staining and immunofluorescence). Integrated transcriptomic and proteomic analyses further elucidated the global molecular landscape underlying the therapeutic effects of JP1. JP1 treatment ameliorated motor deficits and extended survival in SOD1-G93A mice without adversely affecting liver or kidney function. JP1 crossed the blood-brain barrier, targeted motor neurons expressing integrin αVβ3, and activated the ERK pathway. This promoted Keap1/Cul3 degradation and Nrf2 nuclear translocation, thereby activating the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway to alleviate oxidative stress. Concurrently, JP1 restored autophagic flux, increased autophagic activity, attenuated motor neuron injury, suppressed neuronal apoptosis, and preserved neuronal structural integrity. The Nrf2 inhibitor ML385 reversed the protective effects of JP1 on survival, motor function, autophagy, oxidative stress, and neuronal apoptosis, which confirms that JP1 acts via the Nrf2 pathway. JP1 acts as a promising coordinator of antioxidant and autophagic processes by targeting the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway, thus highlighting its therapeutic potential for ALS.
items.titleZh: JP1肽通过Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路调节ALS模型小鼠的氧化应激和自噬
items.summaryZh: 这项研究在ALS小鼠模型（SOD1-G93A）中测试了一种名为JP1的合成肽。JP1源自JWA蛋白，能穿过血脑屏障并靶向运动神经元。结果显示，JP1通过激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路，同时减轻氧化应激并恢复自噬功能，从而改善小鼠的运动能力并延长生存期。该效应依赖于Nrf2，因为使用Nrf2抑制剂ML385会逆转这些保护作用。JP1未引起明显的肝肾毒性。
items.insight: 这项研究值得ALS研究者关注，因为它首次证明单一肽类分子（JP1）能够同时靶向氧化应激和自噬两大关键病理机制，通过Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路实现协同调节，为ALS治疗提供了新的多效性候选药物，并揭示了JWA衍生肽的转化潜力。

items.abstractZh: 同时调节氧化应激和自噬是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的潜在治疗策略，但能够协调调控这两个过程的药物仍然稀缺。Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路是连接氧化还原稳态和自噬调节的关键枢纽，使其成为ALS干预的有吸引力的靶点。JWA是一种应激反应蛋白，参与细胞对抗氧化损伤的保护，其神经保护作用已被证明依赖于MEK/ERK-Nrf2轴的激活。JP1是源自JWA蛋白的功能性寡肽，经过工程化设计可穿越血脑屏障并特异性靶向整合素αVβ3。基于JWA与Nrf2信号传导之间的联系，我们假设JP1激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路以协调抗氧化防御和自噬清除。在此，我们在SOD1-G93A小鼠模型（一种成熟的家族性ALS转基因模型）中评估了这一假设，并阐明了潜在机制。我们通过行为表型和生存分析评估了JP1在SOD1-G93A小鼠中的疗效。通过分析脊髓组织中的Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路和氧化应激、量化自噬通量（通过Western blotting和透射电子显微镜）和神经元凋亡，以及评估组织学（通过Nissl染色和免疫荧光），研究了协调机制。整合转录组学和蛋白质组学分析进一步阐明了JP1治疗效果背后的全局分子景观。JP1治疗改善了SOD1-G93A小鼠的运动缺陷并延长了生存期，且未对肝脏或肾脏功能产生不良影响。JP1穿越血脑屏障，靶向表达整合素αVβ3的运动神经元，并激活ERK通路。这促进了Keap1/Cul3降解和Nrf2核转位，从而激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路以减轻氧化应激。同时，JP1恢复了自噬通量，增加了自噬活性，减轻了运动神经元损伤，抑制了神经元凋亡，并保持了神经元结构完整性。Nrf2抑制剂ML385逆转了JP1对生存、运动功能、自噬、氧化应激和神经元凋亡的保护作用，这证实了JP1通过Nrf2通路发挥作用。JP1通过靶向Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路，作为抗氧化和自噬过程的协调者，凸显了其在ALS中的治疗潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究具有新近性（2026年发表）和ALS相关性，且JP1作为可穿越血脑屏障的肽类，展示了同时调节氧化应激和自噬的转化价值。

items.source: Zhen ci yan jiu = Acupuncture research
items.title: ["Jiaji" (EX-B2) electroacupuncture modulates NLRP3 inflammasome activation to improve limb dysfunction in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis mice].
items.summary: To investigate the regulatory effect of "Jiaji" (EX-B2) electroacupuncture (EA) on the NOD-like receptor thermal protein domain-associated protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome in the lumbar spinal cord and to explore its mechanism in improving limb dysfunction in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) mice. Fifty-four mice carrying the human superoxide dismutase 1 G93A (hSOD1 G93A ) gene were randomly divided into model, Jiaji EA, and inhibitor groups, with 18 mice per group. Eighteen mice not carrying the hSOD1 G93A gene served as wild group. At 60 d of age, the Jiaji EA group was given EA at L1-L2 and L5-L6 EX-B2 points with continuous wave, 1 mA, 2 Hz. The needles retained for 20 min, twice every week. The inhibitor group received intraperitoneal injection of the NLRP3 inhibitor (10 mg/kg, twice every week). All treatments were administered for 4 consecutive weeks. The survival period of mice in each group was observed to assess disease progression；the rotarod test was conducted to evaluate motor coordination and limb motor function；HE staining was used to observe pathological changes in the gastrocnemius, and muscle atrophy was assessed by measuring the cross-sectional area of the gastrocnemius fiber；Nissl staining was performed to evaluate the number of motor neurons in the lumbar spinal cord anterior horns；the protein expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1, apoptosis-associated speck-like protein (ASC), interleukin-1β (IL-1β), interleukin-18 (IL-18), and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) in the lumbar spinal cord were detected by Western blot；the mRNA expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1, ASC, IL-1β, IL-18, and TNF-α were detected by real-time quantitative PCR. Compared with the wild group, mice in the model group exhibited shortened survival time ( P <0.01)；reduced time spent on the rotating rod starting from the 13 th week of age ( P <0.05)；significantly shorter and rounded gastrocnemius fibers with enlarged inter-fiber spaces, nuclear translocation and leakage. The cross-sectional area of the gastrocnemius fibers was reduced ( P <0.01)；the number of motor neurons in the spinal anterior horns was decreased ( P <0.01)；protein and mRNA expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1, ASC, IL-1β, IL-18, and TNF-α were increased in the lumbar spinal cord ( P <0.01). Compared with the model group, survival time was prolonged in the Jiaji EA and inhibitor groups ( P <0.01)；rotarod time was prolonged starting from the 13 th week of age ( P <0.05)；gastrocnemius fibers exhibited more regular margins and larger morphology, with reduced inter-fiber spaces, and reduced number of rounded fibers and improvement in nuclear translocation and leakage；cross-sectional areas of gastrocnemius fiber were increased ( P <0.01)；the numbers of motor neurons in the spinal anterior horns were increased ( P <0.01)；protein and mRNA expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1, ASC, IL-1β, IL-18, and TNF-α decreased in the lumbar spinal cord ( P <0.05, P <0.01). Compared with the inhibitor group, mice in the Jiaji EA group exhibited prolonged rotarod time from the 17 th week of age ( P <0.05)；the cross-sectional area of the gastrocnemius fiber increased ( P <0.05)；protein and mRNA expressions of NLRP3, Caspase-1 and IL-18 in the lumbar spinal cord were higher ( P <0.05, P <0.01), while protein and mRNA expressions of TNF-α were lower ( P <0.05, P <0.01). items.summaryZh: 这项研究在hSOD1 G93A ALS小鼠模型中测试了“夹脊”电针（EX-B2）的疗效。结果显示，电针治疗可延长小鼠生存期、改善转棒运动表现、减轻腓肠肌萎缩并增加脊髓前角运动神经元数量。机制上，电针降低了腰段脊髓中NLRP3、Caspase-1、ASC、IL-1β、IL-18和TNF-α的蛋白及mRNA表达，提示其通过抑制NLRP3炎性小体介导的神经炎症发挥作用。与NLRP3抑制剂相比，电针在部分运动功能指标上表现更优，但NLRP3、Caspase-1和IL-18表达水平相对较高，而TNF-α更低，提示两者机制不完全相同。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS的非药物干预提供了新的实验证据，将传统针灸疗法与现代神经炎症机制（NLRP3炎性小体通路）联系起来。对于关注ALS神经炎症靶点和探索补充疗法的研究者，这项研究提示电针可能通过调节固有免疫炎症通路发挥神经保护作用，值得进一步验证其在其他ALS模型及临床中的可转化性。

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种和军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化症发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项大型队列研究分析了美国退伍军人中军种和军衔与ALS发病率的关系。研究发现，与陆军相比，空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役与更高的ALS风险相关，而海军陆战队风险较低。军官的ALS风险高于士兵，且服役年限越长风险越低。这些差异在年轻退伍军人中更为显著。研究提示特定军事环境暴露可能增加ALS风险，但具体暴露因素尚待识别。
items.insight: 这项研究是迄今规模最大的关于军事服役特征与ALS风险关联的队列研究之一，覆盖超过900万退伍军人，提供了军种和军衔对ALS风险影响的详细分层数据。其发现提示军官和特定军种（如空军、海军）可能暴露于独特的风险因素，为未来识别具体暴露（如电磁场、化学物质、职业压力等）提供了重要线索，对ALS病因学研究具有直接指导价值。

items.abstractZh: 军事服役是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）最一致的风险因素之一，但关于军事服役的哪些方面重要，目前知之甚少。了解军人中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国（US）军种和军衔与偶发ALS的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，包括2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。偶发ALS通过医疗记录确定。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。风险使用Cox比例风险模型估计，控制年龄，调整种族/民族，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例偶发ALS病例，平均年龄56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例，随访开始时平均年龄42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与更高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役与较低的发病率相关（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役年限与较低的ALS发病率相关。在年龄分层模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在年轻男性（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51）中最大，在年长男性（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）中最小。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而有显著差异，年轻退伍军人中的差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2024年截止的全国性纵向队列数据，首次系统量化了军种和军衔对ALS风险的影响，具有高度的ALS病因学相关性和转化价值。
